description: This Java source file defines a REST controller class 'AccountController' for handling account-related HTTP requests in a banking application. It provides endpoints for retrieving account details, adding new accounts, transferring funds, and fetching transaction history.

classes.name: AccountController
classes.description: Rest controller providing endpoints for account and transaction operations in the banking app.

methods.name: getByAccountNumber
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve account details by account number.

methods.name: addNewAccount
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new account for an existing customer.

methods.name: transferDetails
methods.description: Handles PUT request to transfer funds between accounts.

methods.name: getTransactionByAccountNumber
methods.description: Handles GET request to fetch all transactions for a given account number.
